jsQR, QR code reader (used by /qr-code-scanner/)
=================================================

jsQR.min.js
  Package:  jsqr 1.4.0 (Apache-2.0), by Cosmo Wolfe
  Source:   https://registry.npmjs.org/jsqr/-/jsqr-1.4.0.tgz
            https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR
  File:     dist/jsQR.js from the package, minified with terser 5.39.0
            (terser -c -m). The code is unchanged apart from minification;
            the result is byte for byte the body of jsDelivr's
            /npm/jsqr@1.4.0/dist/jsQR.min.js. It defines the global function
            jsQR(data, width, height, options) and also runs in a Web Worker.
